content: Truly interrupting an in-flight transformers generate() on CUDA/ROCm cannot be done by killing an asyncio task or a thread — Python threads can't be forcibly interrupted mid C-extension call, and there is no cancel-in-flight-kernel API. The two real levers are (1) StoppingCriteria checked between autoregressive steps (fast if forward passes are short) or (2) OS-level process kill (guaranteed but destroys any GPU context/resident model in that process).
